title: Finance Systems Specialist (12 months contract)
description:
Finance Systems Specialist (12 months contract)

Asia / Hong Kong
Finance & Administration – Finance /
Full-time: Remote /
Remote

apply for this job
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

We are seeking a qualified accountant with strong systems and project management experience to own the transformation of our internal inventory system. This is an individual contributor role at the intersection of finance operations, product management, and technology. You will act as product owner for the inventory platform — driving enhancements, integrations, and data migrations end-to-end. In a tech-crunch environment, you must be self-sufficient: comfortable building tools, scripts, and AI-driven workflows independently to solve problems without a dedicated engineering team.

Responsibilities

  • Own the inventory system roadmap: plan enhancements, draft BRDs/PRDs, and lead end-to-end delivery from design through UAT to release.
  • Lead UAT cycles: define test plans, execute QA, and sign off before deployment.
  • Troubleshoot system issues — build self-service diagnostic scripts where possible rather than relying on engineering.
  • Drive ERP integration and build automated data pipelines when engineering support is unavailable.
  • Plan and execute data migrations with scripting and AI-assisted tooling for validation and reconciliation.
  • Identify, design, and implement automation and AI-driven workflows across finance operations (JE generation, bank reconciliation, data extraction, reporting, exception handling).
  • Build and maintain self-service tools, dashboards, and scripts (Python, SQL, Excel/VBA, low-code platforms) to enable the finance team to operate independently.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI/ML tools (LLMs, copilots, RPA) into day-to-day operations to reduce manual effort.
  • Maintain system documentation — leverage AI to keep BRDs, runbooks, and user guides current.
  • Support ad-hoc finance transformation initiatives with a bias toward scalable, repeatable solutions over one-off manual work.

Requirements

  • 3-5 years in FinTech, Financial Services, or fast-moving tech environments.
  • Qualified accountant (CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent) with multi-currency accounting experience.
  • Hands-on ERP experience (SAP, Workday, NetSuite) including integrations or migrations.
  • Hands-on ability to build tools independently — Python, SQL, and/or VBA; comfortable with low-code platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI tools (LLMs, copilots, RPA) to automate analysis, documentation, testing, or workflows.
  • Strong Excel skills for large-dataset reconciliation and data validation.
  • Self-starter comfortable operating autonomously in ambiguous, resource-constrained environments.
  • Passion for crypto and blockchain technology.
Why Binance
• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

title: Machine Learning Engineer ($400k - $600k salary)
description:
The Company

Baton Corporation is the development company that builds and operates the entire technology stack behind pump.fun, the largest memecoin launchpad in production today. The systems are low latency, high throughput, live under constant load, and break if you get them wrong.

What You’ll Do

As a Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll work alongside engineers and product teams to build algorithms that power personalisation, recommendations, search and real-time decision-making. Your primary focus will be recommendation systems, with opportunities to apply machine learning to fraud detection and content moderation.

You’ll take projects from initial problem definition through to deployment and iteration, owning the models, data pipelines and supporting infrastructure needed to deliver results.

  • Design, develop and deploy recommendation models that improve discovery, personalisation, engagement and retention.

  • Build scalable data pipelines and use large datasets to develop features, train models and inform product development.

  • Develop and optimise machine learning infrastructure, ensuring training and inference systems are scalable, efficient and reliable in production.

  • Work closely with product teams to integrate models into the platform, supporting low-latency inference and real-time data processing.

  • Design experiments and combine offline evaluation with A/B testing to measure impact and guide improvements.

  • Experiment with techniques across deep learning, natural language processing and reinforcement learning where they can solve meaningful product problems.

  • Monitor, optimise and iterate on deployed models as user behaviour, data and product needs evolve.

  • Develop models for fraud detection, abuse prevention and content moderation to improve platform quality and user experience.

  • Collaborate with engineers and data scientists to solve challenges involving high-volume, on-chain and user activity data.

  • Identify useful developments in ML research and turn them into practical improvements.

Who You Are

  • An experienced Machine Learning Engineer with a strong foundation in algorithms, data structures and statistical modelling.

  • Experienced in building and deploying recommendation systems in production, with measurable improvements to user experience or business outcomes. This is our highest-priority area of experience.

  • Familiar with retrieval, ranking and personalisation techniques, including embeddings, candidate generation and challenges such as cold starts and sparse data.

  • Proficient in Python and frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch, with strong software engineering skills and hands-on experience deploying models.

  • Skilled in building and maintaining ML infrastructure, including data pipelines, model deployment, monitoring and systems that scale to large datasets.

  • Comfortable working across the entire ML lifecycle, from research and experimentation to deployment and maintenance.

  • Experienced working in startups, delivering at a high pace through ambiguity, shifting priorities and limited resources.

  • Hands-on and resourceful, willing to build the models, pipelines and infrastructure yourself to get a solution into production.

  • High-agency and ownership-driven, capable of identifying problems, making decisions and leading projects end to end with minimal guidance.

  • Highly collaborative, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to engineers, product teams and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience with production fraud detection, abuse prevention or content moderation systems will be highly advantageous.

  • An interest in blockchain, crypto and SocialFi technologies is a plus.

What it's like to work here

  • We work in person

  • Hours can be long and unconventional

  • The pace is intense

  • Expectations are high, and impact is immediate

  • Working at Baton is not for everyone

Why Join Us?

  • Unmatched ownership and autonomy

  • Exposure to systems operating at the edge of crypto scale

  • The ability to ship fast and see real-world impact immediately

If you’re motivated by responsibility, speed, and building products used by massive audiences, you’ll feel at home here.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
As Senior Legal Counsel, you will sit at the heart of Grove's legal function, partnering daily with the different teams across transactions, product development, and general corporate matters. You will work directly with the General Counsel, with exposure to a wide range of legal matters and a fast path to owning them independently. On the transaction side, you will support deals from term sheet through closing and post-closing administration. Beyond that, you will act as counsel to the teams building and our products, support corporate governance and commercial contracting across a growing multi-entity group, and build the legal frameworks and playbooks that let the business move fast.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-end transaction management, including preparation of agreements, negotiation of commercial and legal positions, and management of closing processes

  • Act as day-to-day legal counsel to the product and engineering teams as they build, launch, and operate blockchain-based financial products

  • Evaluate the legal and regulatory impact of new product features, initiatives, and strategic business opportunities

  • Review and advise on marketing materials, promotional campaigns, and public communications

  • Track legal, regulatory, and enforcement developments affecting digital assets, tokenization, securities, and financial services, and translate them into practical guidance for the business

  • Build and run internal training on legal and compliance topics

  • Contribute to corporate transactions, governance matters, and other strategic projects as they arise

  • Instruct and manage external counsel where specialist input is needed

Our Ideal Candidate

  • Wants to work at the leading edge of onchain capital markets

  • Naturally curious and eager to learn, and comfortable working on new and unfamiliar problems

  • Able to prioritize effectively and adapt quickly as priorities evolve

  • Takes ownership of problems and drives matters forward with minimal supervision

  • Entrepreneurial and hands-on, with a willingness to roll up their sleeves

  • Collaborative and team-oriented, with practical business judgment

Requirements

  • Qualified lawyer admitted to practice in a recognized jurisdiction

  • 4+ years of post-qualification experience in BigLaw, a comparable in-house role, or a combination of both

  • Transactional background in one or more of finance, securitization, project finance, structured finance, capital markets, corporate/M&A, or tax

  • Comfortable operating as a generalist, equally at home supporting transactions, product launches, corporate governance, commercial contracts, and day-to-day legal matters

  • Experience managing transactions and negotiating with sophisticated counterparties

  • Strong drafting and research skills and experience working with and managing external counsel

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Bonus: experience in digital assets, DeFi, or other blockchain-based financial products

What's In It For You

  • Work at the heart of the Grove ecosystem on high-impact, first-of-their-kind transactions alongside a leading crypto-native financial advisory team

  • Exposure across an exceptional breadth of matters, from structured credit transactions and tokenized products to regulatory strategy and corporate work

  • Help shape the legal and financial infrastructure underpinning the growth of onchain finance and tokenized real-world assets

  • Competitive compensation

  • Significant responsibility and exposure to sophisticated counterparties across traditional finance and digital assets

  • Remote-first, highly collaborative team of experts across finance, engineering, risk, legal, and governance

  • Opportunities to travel for team events and industry conferences

title: Enterprise Blockchain Architect (Digital Assets & Tokenization)
description:
Type of work: Hybrid (New Jersey / New York)


The Opportunity

Financial infrastructure is shifting on-chain, and Maxima Consulting is looking for a Blockchain Architect to shape the enterprise platforms driving that transformation.

In this high-impact role, you will lead the end-to-end architecture and solution strategy for institutional digital asset platforms—focusing on Real-World Asset (RWA) tokenization, digital securities, and institutional custody workflows. You will bridge complex Web3 protocols with enterprise-grade reliability, security, and compliance.

If you thrive at the intersection of deep protocol knowledge, full-stack Web3 architecture, and technical leadership, this is your opportunity to build systems that operate at institutional scale.


What You’ll Do

  • Drive Platform Architecture: Design and deploy resilient, scalable end-to-end architectures connecting React/Next.js frontends, backend microservices, smart contracts, and EVM networks.
  • Architect Digital Asset Solutions: Lead the technical design for RWA tokenization, digital securities, and institutional custody workflows across public EVM and enterprise chains (e.g., Hyperledger Besu, Kaleido).
  • Secure Smart Contracts: Establish protocols for smart contract design, upgradeability, gas optimization, and audit governance across institutional standards (ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, ERC-3643, ERC-1400).
  • Integrate Institutional Custody: Design secure transaction-signing workflows and integration strategies for top-tier MPC wallet providers (Fireblocks, DFNS, Turnkey, BitGo).
  • Embed Compliance & Security: Build regulatory-first architecture incorporating KYC/AML controls, transaction monitoring, and security best practices into core tokenization workflows.
  • Lead Architecture Governance: Establish Web3 coding standards, author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), define technical roadmaps, and mentor engineering teams through production releases.

What We’re Looking For

  • Enterprise Blockchain Mastery: Proven experience architecting and shipping enterprise-grade digital asset and tokenization solutions.
  • Full-Stack & Web3 Expertise: Hands-on architecture experience using Node.js, Go, or Rust, alongside React/Next.js frontends and Web3 libraries (Ethers.js, Viem, Wagmi).
  • Institutional Tokenization & Custody: Deep fluency in permissioned token standards (ERC-3643, ERC-1400) and enterprise MPC wallet integrations.
  • EVM & Enterprise Chains: Technical command of EVM networks and enterprise platforms like Hyperledger Besu and Kaleido.
  • Technical Leadership: Exceptional track record in setting architectural strategy, leading code/audit reviews, and guiding cross-functional delivery teams.
  • Location & Availability: Ability to work on a hybrid schedule in the New Jersey / New York area and available for an immediate interview process.

Must have:

  • Token Standards: ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, ERC-3643, ERC-1400
  • Blockchain Networks: Public EVM Networks, Hyperledger Besu, Kaleido
  • Web3 Libraries & Tooling: Ethers.js, Viem, Wagmi
  • Languages & Tech: Node.js, Go, Rust, React, Next.js
  • Custody & MPC: Fireblocks, DFNS, Turnkey, BitGo
  • Compliance & Ops: KYC/AML integration, Transaction Monitoring, Smart Contract Auditing, ADRs

Recruitment process: Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. Please note that due to the volume of applications, we will only contact selected candidates.


How we work: Being a people-centric company, we highly value our employees, as they are the true strength of Maxima. Regardless of your gender, religion, location, and age, you are welcome here. Maxima is a team of long-term thinkers focused on sustainability and growth with a proven track record of long-lasting partnerships with our clients and employees.
